Mabuhay, racers! Drag Race Philippines Season 4 premieres September 25 ONLY on WOW Presents Plus: https://bit.ly/46mChlb

Following the massive success of Drag Race Philippines Season 3 and the acclaimed Slaysian Royale edition, Drag Race Philippines returns for its fourth season—bigger, bolder, and fiercer than ever. Twelve queens enter the competition, ready to prove they have the charisma, uniqueness, nerve, and talent to join the franchise’s growing hall of legends. With bigger challenges, shocking twists, unforgettable runways, and the most competitive race yet, every episode pushes the queens to their limits in pursuit of the crown and the title of the Philippines’ next Drag Superstar.
